name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Marketing Content Writer
summary: B2B content writer and copywriter with hands-on experience translating technical, systems-level concepts into clear marketing content: thought leadership, newsletters, direct-response copy, and SEO-friendly web content. Writes both AI-assisted and by hand across a 15-year career, and moves comfortably between web copy, email sequences, and long-form educational content without losing brand voice.

bullets: Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Draft clean, specific, ethically aligned direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Translate non-technical stakeholders' generalized ideas and feedback into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions - acting as the bridge between business intent and reliable LLM output.
Build reusable marketing assets and messaging frameworks, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand and vertical rather than starting from scratch each time.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog, ensuring published content is SEO-friendly and optimized for conversion.
Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, complex email sequences, conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline, designing the page layout and structure, not just the copy on them.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to share structured, high-priority customer feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
